# OPHTML

> Over Powered HTML 1.1.1: a browser-only ES module for .htm components, templates, configurable CSS utilities, and animations. No build step or runtime dependencies.

Canonical runtime: dyHTML/ophtml.js. Default export: { html, script, style }.
Start with `import OPHTML from './dyHTML/ophtml.js'; const _dy = OPHTML.html;`.
Set `_dy.root = '/components/';`, then `await _dy.render('name', params)` and insert HTML.
Do not infer APIs from the project name. There is no reactive binding system.

## Essential constraints

- Use `.htm`, `$$name`, and documented # directives, not JSX/mustache syntax.
- Repeat object arrays in `<repeater params="$$items">`, in a dedicated wrapper.
- Per-item condition/expression forms: `#_is ... #_then ... #_else ... #_end`, `#_dy(EXPR#_)`.
- `_dy.style.use(config)` installs utilities. `_dyStyle` is a compatibility alias.
- `op-fade-in`, `op-slide-up`, `op-spin` CSS works after import.
- `_dy.animate(selector, 'fadeIn', options)` returns Animation/null; await `.finished`.
- No automatic UI updates. Render again or modify DOM explicitly.
- Register resource cleanup with _dy.onDispose(tid, callback). Await _dy.dispose(tidOrElement) to release state, or _dy.unmount(element) to also clear DOM. _dy.isDisposed(tid) includes pending disposal/unknown IDs.
- Manual render strings need their TID retained via render(name, data, true) for reliable cleanup. innerHTML replacement alone does not dispose components.
- Repeater/switcher/com/loader hooks compile to HTMLElement-based op-* signals; hookMode='legacy' retains image triggers. <switch> aliases <switcher>.
- <if test="$$available">Yes<else>No</else></if> chooses once on connection; #if remains unchanged. See docs/templates.md for structure and async errors.
- render awaits its own initialization, not connection/image hooks or nested requests after insertion.
- Templates execute trusted JS and interpolate raw HTML. Escape/sanitize untrusted data.
- Serve over HTTP; preserve the legacy eval/inline-hook environment when setting CSP.
